citations.title: PJM, 2020–2024 Weighted Average EFORd by Fuel Type (Class Average Values effective 1 June 2025)
citations.parameter: FOR = PJM Diesel–Utility WEFORd 10.185 % (proxy: reciprocating engines)

notes: Expected hourly availability = (1-FOR)*(1-planned share)*(1-ambient derate); FOR=0.102, planned outage 7 d/yr. Proxy statistics from US utility reciprocating engines; planned outage days/yr is a modelling assumption. Feedstock/digester seasonality not modelled.
